messages.author: 1c6fdf69a26a38bf
messages.subject: Shiny Over Windows Server ?
parts:
Hi,

I am new to Shiny and 'R'. Is it possible to deploy apps on windows server using Shiny or does it only works with Linux? I was also looking for ways to integrate R into Asp.Net applications. Is it possible with Shiny?

Thanks,
Suman

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Shiny Over Windows Server ?
parts:
Shiny Server is only for Linux for the moment, but we will likely support Windows in the coming months.

Shiny is probably not the way you want to integrate R into ASP.NET (assuming you just want to use R as a calculation engine). You might consider R (D)COM or R.NET.
